label: Learning rate
intent: The learning rate steps down on its schedule. Light: the second step size drops to its shorter length and stops dead, and the third follows a beat later and drops further. Strong: a step decay in two milestones: at the first both later steps drop to the middle length in turn, and at the second the last step halves again. The first step stays fixed; the sizes are data and never overshoot.

step-1.//: the third step: right end from x 27 to x 12

step-0.//: the second step: right end from x 27 to x 19

decay-1.//: 0.533 is the middle length (14), the first milestone
